articles.headline: QB Sam Darnold back Sunday, but Seahawks down two safeties
articles.description: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold will start Sunday, but the defending Super Bowl champions will be without both starting safeties as Julian Love and Ty Okada have been ruled out.

articles.headline: Commanders rule RG Cosmi, TE Okonkwo, LB Luvu out Sunday
articles.description: Right guard Sam Cosmi (concussion), tight end Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) and linebacker Frankie Luvu (groin) won't play Sunday vs. the Seahawks.
